sql:
select 'exp' k, e.key a, e.state b, '' c from experiments e where e.key in ('mmsell-price-ceiling','mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity','mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap','mmsell-price-ceiling-size-split','mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size','mmsell-win-set','mmsell-win-set-2','mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size-2','mmsell-win-set-3')
union all
select 'ie', i.kind, coalesce(d.deployment_key,'-'), i.detected_at::text from experiment_integrity_events i left join experiment_deployments d on d.id=i.deployment_id where i.detected_at > '2026-11-01 22:15'
union all
select 'iss', i.issue_key||' '||i.status||' '||i.current_owner_role, e.key, left(i.title,110) from experiment_issues i join experiments e on e.id=i.experiment_id where i.resolved_at is null and e.key in ('mmsell-price-ceiling','mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity','mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap','mmsell-price-ceiling-size-split','mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size','mmsell-win-set','mmsell-win-set-2')
union all
select 'pt', strategy, count(*)::text, max(created_at)::text from paper_trades where created_at > '2026-11-01 23:02:10' group by strategy
